products.description: Advanced infant formula for newborns up to 6 months, enriched with essential nutrients for immunity and cognitive development. Contains DHA, HMOs, and antioxidants.
key_ingredients: DHA (Docosahexaenoic Acid) - Omega fatty acids for development
Cow's Milk Fat - Primary component of the formula
HMOs (Human Milk Oligosaccharides) - Immune system development
Vitamin C - Antioxidant and immunity enhancement
Vitamin D - Bone and teeth development
Iron - Anemia prevention and red blood cell health
usage_guidelines: Wash the feeding cup and boil for 5 minutes, then place on a clean surface
In a separate container, boil water for 5 minutes and let it cool
Pour sufficient pre-boiled lukewarm water into the sterilized feeding cup
Fill the attached scoop by pressing against the can and scraping excess with a knife
Add powder to water and mix well until completely dissolved
